content:
<thought>To avoid possible parsing limits, I will retrieve the remaining oxide polymorphs in two smaller batches. First batch will include the next 15 oxides. After that I will list the generated files, then retrieve the final batch of the remaining compositions, and finally consolidate all JSON files (including the first five already retrieved) into one dataset.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "ZnO","MgO","CaO","SrO","BaO","CoO","NiO","MnO","Cr2O3","V2O5",
        "MoO3","WO3","PbO","PbO2","SnO2"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
